info.name: Techno
info.description: Techno at 128 to 138 BPM: rumble, acid, polymeters and an industrial song.

songs.name: Industrial Techno
songs.description: An industrial techno song in D minor at 138 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, main, break, peak and outro on the four Industrial Techno patterns. The hats fill in over the intro and the kick's rumble opens up; the bass's filter opens and resonates over the main part, kick and rumble drop out for the last measure before the break; the drone gets crushed over the break while the snare's echo runs away; the clangs throw into the echo at the end of each phrase of the peak; over the outro the rumble fades out and the hats thin out.

patterns.name: Techno
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, open hat on each &, 16th closed hats around it, clap on 2 and 4, syncopated rimshots on 1a, 2&, 3a and 4e; crash every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Acid Squelch
patterns.description: Acid techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor over a 16-step squelchy bass (octave jumps, a minor third and a seventh, accents on the jumps) through a resonant low-pass swept over 8 seconds.

patterns.name: Techno Polymeter
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, closed hats accented every 3 steps, rimshot every 5 steps with a dotted-8th delay, tom every 7 steps drifting in pitch on an LFO; high-pass on the hats swept over 4 measures, crash every 16 passes.

patterns.name: Techno Rumble
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick in a hall, a low-passed reverb kick on every e, & and a for the rumble with its cutoff on a slow LFO, clap on 2 and 4 with a dotted-8th delay, 16th hats gated by probability, ride on each &; 32nd snare roll on 4 every 8 passes, crash every 8.

patterns.name: Techno Acid
patterns.description: Acid techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, 16th hats gated by probability, synth bass arpeggio (0, 3, 7, 10, 12 up and down) on a 7-of-16 euclidean rhythm through a resonant low-pass swept over 4 measures, euclidean cowbell (3 of 8); snare build from 16ths to 32nds on 4 every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Industrial Techno Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Industrial Techno demo, 4 measures in D minor at 138 BPM, all synth sounds: a distorted, clipped 909 kick, its rumble (a low tom in a hall, low-passed and ducked by the kick), crushed 16th hats gated by probability, metal clangs a tritone apart and sparse metallic snare shots.

patterns.name: Industrial Techno Main
patterns.description: The main part of the Industrial Techno demo, 4 measures in D minor at 138 BPM: distorted kick and rumble, a crushed clap on 2 and 4, hats and off-beat open hats, metal clangs in ping-pong delay, metallic snare shots and a rolling FM bass on the three 16ths after each kick, ducked by the kick.

patterns.name: Industrial Techno Break
patterns.description: The break of the Industrial Techno demo, 4 measures in D minor: no kick and no bass, a drone grinding D against E flat under a slow filter sweep, a crushed siren in ping-pong delay, the clangs and the hats; the metallic snare rolls in 16ths over the last measure.

patterns.name: Industrial Techno Peak
patterns.description: The peak of the Industrial Techno demo, 4 measures in D minor at 138 BPM: the main part with a crash on the first beat, a crushed ride on the 8ths, the drone low underneath and the siren on the last measure.
